mistake_reason: Reasoning-Action Mismatch (FM-2.6): The orchestrator and assistant explicitly required Google Maps walking directions between Adrenalinpark Köln (Köhlstraße 10) and Le Mans Karting (Köhlstraße 37) using the exact addresses and walking mode. At step 20, WebSurfer stated they pasted the exact addresses and selected walking mode, but in execution they followed an auto-complete to a mismatched destination (Köhlstraße 37 outside the intended area) and used non-walking routing, then reported the resulting time as walking (≈14 minutes). This contradicted the stated plan and logical conclusion that same-street addresses likely yield ≤10 minutes. The erroneous action produced inflated times and led the team to conclude "none" qualifies, causing the final wrong answer.
